process.title: Tell Us What You Need
process.copy: Share your project, goals, audience, style, and deadline.

process.title: Understand Your Brand
process.copy: We review your brief, brand voice, references, and objectives.

process.title: Writing & Research
process.copy: The assigned writer researches and creates content according to the brief.

process.title: Review & Refinement
process.copy: Content is quality-checked and revised within the agreed scope.

process.title: Delivery
process.copy: Final content is delivered in the agreed format and timeline.

faqs.question: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide white-label content support for agencies that need reliable additional writing capacity.

faqs.question: Can you match our brand voice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Content is tailored to the brand guidelines, tone, audience, and objectives in the brief.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing content support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can support recurring blogs, website updates, campaigns, and other ongoing content.

faqs.question: Can I request revisions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Revisions are handled according to the agreed project scope.

faqs.question: How do you price projects?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on content type, word count, research, complexity, and turnaround. A custom quote is provided after reviewing the brief.

faqs.question: Do you provide PR/media placement?
faqs.answer: We provide PR and press release writing. Media placement, where available, is quoted separately.
